decision: Lead with one operating thesis, then prove it screen by screen
why: Reviewers remember a point of view before a feature list.
alternative: A grid of technologies and logos.
value: Every later screen reads as evidence for the same claim.

decision: Only measured outcomes from real systems appear as metrics; everything else is labelled synthetic
why: Portfolio truthfulness is a product requirement, not a disclaimer.
alternative: Blend demo numbers with real outcomes.
value: No accidental overclaiming; the marquee is quotable.

decision: Four independently deployed zones behind one domain
why: Each product has a different stack and release rhythm, like real teams.
value: Independent deploys with a single URL for reviewers.

decision: AI is one capability with one trust pattern, not the identity of the work
why: The portfolio is about whole-system engineering; AI earns its place per decision.
value: Product and architecture range stay visible.

decision: Each founding-engineer need links straight to the live screen that shows it
why: Claims are cheap; a clickable proof is not.
